meta.title: Inpaint with InpaintModelConditioning
meta.about: The third route: the original stays in the latent and the greyed copy goes in the conditioning.
needs: An inpainting checkpoint, or another model whose class has concat_keys. An ordinary SD 1.5 file ignores the concat values.

notes.5: Paint a mask in the image editor. It arrives on the second output.
notes.6: Writes concat_latent_image and concat_mask into both conditionings, and returns the encoded original with a soft noise_mask.
notes.7: Can run below full denoise, because the latent holds the original.
